items.title: Tesla's Cybercab event is tonight. Here's what the industry — and Wall Street — expects
items.summary: Tesla will take the wraps off its production Cybercab purpose-built robotaxi in Austin later today, marking a potential turning point for the company's self-driving ambitions.

items.title: Tesla's Cybercab to take center stage at Austin event
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) will be holding an event for its driverless Cybercab in Austin, Texas, on Thursday. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian breaks down what to expect from the EV company and its robotaxi service.

items.title: Elon Musk sends a strong message to Tesla and SpaceX investors
items.summary: Now comes the hard part, he openly admitted.

items.title: Tesla keeps hyping robotaxis as its future. But it’s trailing rival Waymo in a field yet to prove profitable
items.summary: Nothing is more important to Tesla than its ambitious plan for self-driving “robotaxis.” But even as it hosts an event for its Cybercab service Thursday, it still has a long way to catch up to the competition in an industry where few have made any money at all.

items.title: Nvidia, Broadcom, Tesla, HPE, Ultragenyx, Snowflake, Robinhood, Ciena, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Nvidia stock rises on a deal for it to acquire Hugging Face whiule Tesla stock advances ahead of an important Cybercab event.

items.title: Tesla Advances 6% as Traders Await Cybercab Event, Lucid Rises 3%, Rivian Ticks Up
items.summary: Tesla is surging ahead of its Cybercab event in Austin while rivals Lucid and Rivian trail behind, but whether the autonomous vehicle showcase delivers the commercial proof traders are pricing in could determine if this rally has legs or sets up a painful reversal.

items.title: Tesla’s Impossible Comeback
items.summary: Tesla once dominated the EV revolution and captivated investors worldwide, but a cascade of forces has put Elon Musk in a corner with no obvious escape route.

items.title: Ford Risks Another Big EV Failure
items.summary: Ford just unveiled its latest electric vehicle with bold sales targets, but the company faces a collision of forces that sank its previous EV ambitions and shows no sign of letting up.
